rust_summary: a thrown potion's say before it applies its effects (`native_potion_splash_v2`).
doc_summary: `native_potion_splash_v2(item, pos, cancel)` is asked before a thrown splash or lingering potion applies its hit effects at `pos`. Set `cancel` and no effect and no cloud is made; `native_potion_splash` is not told then. Experience bottles are not asked. Bundles need "hooks": @API:potion_splash_v2@.
